description: Create a new Google Slides presentation with the given title. Returns its id. Requires a connected account.
embedding_description: Create a brand-new Google Slides presentation with a given title (starting with Google's default single title slide). Returns the created presentation's id, which is then the 'id' argument for slides_get, slides_batch_update, and slides_export. Fails gsuite.not_connected if no account is linked.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dict with the new presentation id.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Confirm the presentation was created and give its id for follow-up edits or export.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Create a new Google Slides presentation.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: gsuite.invalid_params: missing title. gsuite.not_connected: no account linked.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: gsuite.invalid_params: supply a title. gsuite.not_connected: run connect_account.
